items.rationale: The attendance and initial survey qualify under §§7.1.7(e)–(f). Allow €175 gross for this first call-out, without duplicating the separately billed pinpointing and moisture measurements.
Necessary work to locate the leak is covered by §7.1.7(e). Allow €175 gross for one targeted test beneath the sink, not a separate charge for the contractor's own instrument.

items.description: Kitchen floor and wall-base moisture measurement
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(e) covers measurements needed to establish the extent of the kitchen damage. Allow €95 gross for the floor and wall-base survey.

Sections 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(c) allow necessary labour at customary rates but not time already included in the survey and test charges. If separate labour is substantiated, allow about 3 hours at €95 gross, not the full 14 hours for this localized investigation.

The attendance on line 1 uses this contractor's single travel or call-out allowance under §7.1.7(f), so the van charge is excluded. If line 1 were treated solely as survey labour, a standalone van charge would be about €65 gross.
Necessary access to the affected pipe is covered under §§7.1.1(b) and 7.1.7(a), limited to the area needed for the repair. Allow about 1.5 hours at €95 gross, rounded to €143.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged insulation
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1 cover removal and disposal of the affected insulation. Allow €44 gross for the two small pieces at about €22 each.

items.description: Repair leaking copper pipe and reinstate insulation
items.rationale: On the evidence of a localized pipe failure, §§2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c), (g) support replacing the short section and restoring like-for-like insulation. Allow about €220 for copper, fittings and consumables, €45 for insulation and €190 for labour, gross.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) restrict drying to areas with established loss-related moisture; only the kitchen was affected. €300 gross is a conditional allowance for a small drying job if roof-space damage were established.
Necessary dryer hire for the affected kitchen is covered under §§7.1.7(b), (e). Allow about 14 days at €18 gross, rounded to €250, provided the hire is not charged again on line 11.

items.description: Dry kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(b), (e) and (g) covers setup, monitoring and completion checks for the affected kitchen surfaces. Allow €380 gross for those services, excluding dryer hire and any measurements already billed under §7.1.8(c).

Section 7.1.8(c) bars charging again for fittings and insulation already included in the plumber's repair; §7.1.8(e) also requires proof that the materials were used. Only distinct, documented materials would qualify, at about €65 gross.
General final cleaning is excluded by §7.1.8(a), even within the affected work area. If separately shown to be removal of loss or repair residues under §5.2.1, allow about €55 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on this contractor's invoice. Allow €65 gross for one local attendance.

items.description: Remove damaged kitchen table from dwelling
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(h) expressly covers removal of the replaced furnishing from the dwelling. Allow €40 gross for carry-out labour, separate from haulage and disposal.

items.description: Transport and dispose of damaged table
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(h) covers transport away and §5.2.1 covers disposal of the damaged insured table. Allow about €45 for haulage and €25 for disposal, gross, without repeating the carry-out charge.
The scheduled new-for-old option under §§4.4 and 7.1.1(d) removes the age deduction. The same model costs €440 net, or €523.60 with 19% VAT actually incurred under §7.7.
Section 7.1.7(h) expressly covers delivery of the replacement furnishing. Allow €45 gross for ordinary local delivery, without paying the same transport cost twice.

items.description: Assemble table and clean its placement area
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(h) covers both setup and cleaning the position where the damaged table stood. Allow €55 gross for simple assembly and localized cleaning.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first distinct travel charge on this invoice, provided it does not repeat the table haulage or delivery. Allow €60 gross for one local attendance.
Section 7.1.7(f) permits only the first travel charge on the invoice, regardless of the number of visits. €60 gross is the conditional value of an ordinary local trip if it qualified.

items.description: Inspect other furniture stored in the garden
items.rationale: Sections 4.2.6, 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) do not cover testing garden-stored furniture not shown to have been affected by the kitchen leak. If the inspection qualified, a brief moisture survey would be about €75 gross.
